questions.question:
Two Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow (s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All boxes are cube.

All cubes are squares.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some boxes are squares.

II. Some squares are not cube.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/639de5a35b6f4bd1716a61eaf346661a0b496309ea3573fdae1a86b1e299565b.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some boxes are squares → True (As All boxes are cube and All cubes are squares so, Some boxes are squares is true)

II. Some squares are not cube → False (It is indefinite, it may or may not be true, Hence, it is considered to be wrong conclusion)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I is true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion I follows".**

questions.question:
Which of the mathematical signs should be interchanged in the below equation to make it mathematically correct?

14 + 63 ÷ 7 - 21 × 35 = 140
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Option 1) + and -

Given equation is: 14 + 63 ÷ 7 - 21 × 35 = 140

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 14 - 63 ÷ 7 + 21 × 35 = 140

⇒ 14 - __**63 ÷ 7**__ + 21 × 35 = 140

⇒ 14 - 9 + __**21 × 35**__ = 140

⇒ __**14**__ - 9 __**+ 735**__ = 140

⇒ __**749 - 9**__ = 140

⇒ 740 ≠ 140

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) ÷ and ×

Given equation is: 14 + 63 ÷ 7 - 21 × 35 = 140

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 14 + 63 × 7 - 21 ÷ 35 = 140

⇒ 14 + 63 × 7 - __**21 ÷ 35**__ = 140

⇒ 14 + __**63 × 7**__ - 0.6 = 140

⇒ __**14 + 441**__ - 0.6 = 140

⇒ __**455**____** - 0.6**__ = 140

⇒ 454.4 ≠ 140

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) - and ×

Given equation is: 14 + 63 ÷ 7 - 21 × 35 = 140

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 14 + 63 ÷ 7 × 21 - 35 = 140

⇒ 14 + __**63 ÷ 7**__ × 21 - 35 = 140

⇒ 14 + __**9 × 21**__ - 35 = 140

⇒ __**14 + 189**__ - 35 = 140

⇒ __**203 - 35**__ = 140

⇒ 168 ≠ 140

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) + and ×

Given equation is: 14 + 63 ÷ 7 - 21 × 35 = 140

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 14 × 63 ÷ 7 - 21 + 35 = 140

⇒ 14 × __**63 ÷ 7**__ - 21 + 35 = 140

⇒ __**14 × 9**__ - 21 + 35 = 140

⇒ __**126**__ - 21 __**+ 35**__ = 140

⇒ __**161 - 21**__ = 140

⇒ **140 = 140**

**LHS = RHS**

Hence, the correct answer is **"+ and ×".**

questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some mobiles are land.

Some land are wide.

All wide are tall.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some mobiles are tall.

II. All tall are wide.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41d5163f7d6e7476a93a13125a2db63344975ab57e6e2acdceb63b15837f72db.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some mobiles are tall → False (As Some mobiles are land and Some land are wide and All wide are tall so, Some mobiles are tall is false)

II. All tall are wide → False (As All wide are tall so, All tall are wide is false)

∴ Here, Both conclusion I and II are false.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Neither conclusion I nor II follows".**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

110 ∶ 23 ∶∶ 85 ∶ ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

Logic: (First number + 5)​ ÷ 5 = Second number.

 
• 110 ∶ 23 → (110 + 5) ÷ 5 = 115 ÷ 5 = 23

Similarly,

 
• 85 ∶ ? → (85 + 5) ÷ 5 = 90 ÷ 5 = 18

Hence, the correct answer is **"18".**

questions.question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

First row - 60, 20, 10

Second row - 90, 30, 15

Third row - 36, 12, ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

Logic: (First number ÷ 2) - Second number

First row - 60, 20, 10 → (60 ÷ 2) - 20 = 30 - 20 = 10.

Second row - 90, 30, 15 → (90 ÷ 2) - 30 = 45 - 30 = 15.

Similarly,

**Third row - 36, 12, ? → (36 ÷ 2) - 12 = 18 - 12 = 6.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"6".**

questions.question:
By interchanging the given two signs which of the following equation will be not correct?

+ and ×

I. 15 + 5 ÷ 1 - 9 × 4 = 70

II. 18 × 17 + 3 - 6 ÷ 2 = 133
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

I. Given equation : 15 + 5 ÷ 1 - 9 × 4 = 70

After interchanging the given two symbols + and × the equation is as follows : 15 × 5 ÷ 1 - 9 + 4 = 70

⇒ 15 × __**5 ÷ 1**__ - 9 + 4 = 70

⇒ __**15 × 5**__ - 9 + 4 = 70

⇒ __**75**__ - 9 __**+ 4**__ = 70

⇒ __**79 - 9**__ = 70

⇒ **70 = 70**

LHS = RHS

II. Given equation : 18 × 17 + 3 - 6 ÷ 2 = 133

After interchanging the given two symbols + and × the equation is as follows : 18 + 17 × 3 - 6 ÷ 2 = 133

⇒ 18 + 17 × 3 - __**6 ÷ 2**__ = 133

⇒ 18 + __**17 × 3**__ - 3 = 133

⇒ __**18 + 51**__ - 3 = 133

⇒ __**69 - 3**__ = 133

⇒ **66 ≠ 133**

**LHS ≠ RHS**

∴ Here, Conclusion II is not correct.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only II".**

questions.question: Amongst seven sisters I, II, III, IV, V, VI and VII, each has a different height. I is shorter than only one sister. II is only taller than VII. Three sisters are shorter than IV and three are taller than her. V is not the tallest. III is shorter than VI but taller than V. Who is the third shortest among the sisters?
questions.solution:
Amongst seven sisters I, II, III, IV, V, VI and VII, each has a different height.

1) III is shorter than VI but taller than V.

VI > III > V

2) II is only taller than VII and I is shorter than only one sister.

___ I > ____ > ____ > ___ > II > VII.

3) Three sisters are shorter than IV and three are taller than her and V is not the tallest.

VI > I > III > IV > V > II > VII

∴ Here, 'V' is the third shortest among the sisters.

Hence, the correct answer is **"V".**
